pr_description: Replaces the internal `BaseGuard`/`InferGuarded` utility types with a single exported `Guard<TInput, TOutput>` type, and collapses the guard() overload set down to the two forms (with and without a custom message) that most consumers use. Makes the guard action's type signature easier to reference from outside the library.
